disease_phenotype: Cystic fibrosis with pulmonary, pancreatic, and GI manifestations

supporting_evidence.claim: F508del CFTR is misfolded and retained in the endoplasmic reticulum, reducing apical chloride channel density.
Elexacaftor and tezacaftor are correctors that stabilize CFTR folding and improve trafficking to the apical membrane.
Ivacaftor is a potentiator that increases the open-channel probability of CFTR at the membrane.
Trikafta (elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor) improved FEV1 by 13.8 percentage points and lowered sweat chloride in F508del CF.

reasoning_trace.content: F508del is a class II CFTR variant: misfolding/processing defect with reduced channel function at the apical membrane.
Triple-modulator regimen targeting both folding (correctors) and gating (potentiator) is indicated.

disease_phenotype: Sickle cell disease with vaso-occlusive crises and chronic hemolytic anemia

supporting_evidence.claim: HbS polymerizes under deoxygenation, causing red cell sickling and vaso-occlusion.
BCL11A represses gamma-globin in adults; disrupting its erythroid enhancer de-represses HbF.
Exa-cel (Casgevy) is an ex-vivo CRISPR-Cas9 therapy editing the BCL11A erythroid enhancer in autologous HSCs.
Casgevy was approved by the FDA in December 2023 for SCD in patients 12 years and older.

reasoning_trace.content: Homozygous HBB E6V (HbS): toxic gain-of-function via deoxy-polymerization.
Re-inducing fetal hemoglobin via BCL11A enhancer disruption avoids direct HBB editing while abrogating sickling.

disease_phenotype: SMA type 1 - severe infantile motor neuron degeneration

supporting_evidence.claim: SMA type 1 is caused by homozygous loss-of-function of SMN1; severity depends on SMN2 copy number.
SMN2 differs from SMN1 by a single nucleotide that disrupts an exon-7 splicing enhancer; most SMN2 transcripts exclude exon 7.
Nusinersen is an intrathecal ASO that promotes SMN2 exon-7 inclusion, restoring full-length SMN protein.
Earlier intervention yields the best motor trajectory; presymptomatic dosing recommended where feasible.

reasoning_trace.content: Homozygous SMN1 LoF; 2 SMN2 copies forecast SMA type 1.
Three approved options: SMN2-splice-modulating ASO (nusinersen), AAV9 SMN1 replacement (onasemnogene), or oral splicing modifier (risdiplam).

disease_phenotype: Hereditary ATTR amyloidosis with polyneuropathy and cardiomyopathy

supporting_evidence.claim: ATTRv is driven by destabilizing TTR mutations causing tetramer dissociation and amyloid fibril formation.
Patisiran is an LNP-formulated siRNA targeting TTR mRNA; vutrisiran is the GalNAc-conjugated subcutaneous successor.
NTLA-2002 is an in vivo CRISPR-Cas9 therapy knocking out hepatic TTR after a single LNP infusion.

reasoning_trace.content: TTR knockdown removes substrate for fibril formation; multiple FDA-approved siRNA and ASO options.

disease_phenotype: Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia with elevated LDL-C

supporting_evidence.claim: PCSK9 binds the hepatic LDL receptor and promotes its lysosomal degradation; PCSK9 inhibition increases LDLR recycling and lowers LDL-C.
Evolocumab and alirocumab are subcutaneous monoclonal antibodies; FOURIER and ODYSSEY OUTCOMES showed cardiovascular event reduction.
Inclisiran is a hepatocyte-targeted siRNA lowering hepatic PCSK9 mRNA, with twice-yearly subcutaneous dosing.

reasoning_trace.content: On maximally tolerated statin with persistent LDL-C; next-line PCSK9 inhibition via mAb or siRNA.

disease_phenotype: Fabry disease - X-linked lysosomal storage disorder with renal, cardiac, and CNS manifestations

supporting_evidence.claim: Classical Fabry disease results from loss of alpha-galactosidase A activity and lysosomal accumulation of globotriaosylceramide.
Agalsidase beta is recombinant human alpha-galactosidase A delivered intravenously every 2 weeks.
Migalastat is an oral pharmacological chaperone for amenable GLA missense variants that improves enzyme folding and lysosomal trafficking.

reasoning_trace.content: Hemizygous null variant excludes chaperone (no residual misfolded protein); ERT with agalsidase beta is the standard.

disease_phenotype: Sickle cell disease - therapeutic editing of BCL11A erythroid enhancer

supporting_evidence.claim: BCL11A is the major postnatal repressor of gamma-globin (HbF); disrupting its erythroid enhancer at the +58 site de-represses HbF.
Exa-cel edits the BCL11A erythroid enhancer in autologous HSCs ex vivo; edited cells are reinfused after myeloablation.

reasoning_trace.content: BCL11A enhancer editing is the molecular target underlying exa-cel's mechanism in SCD/beta-thalassemia.

disease_phenotype: Acute intermittent porphyria - heme biosynthesis pathway disorder driven by HMBS deficiency

supporting_evidence.claim: In acute hepatic porphyrias, HMBS deficiency leads to accumulation of upstream porphyrin precursors during ALAS1 induction.
Givosiran is a GalNAc-conjugated siRNA that knocks down hepatic ALAS1 mRNA, reducing precursor accumulation and attack frequency.
ENVISION trial demonstrated reduced attack rate with givosiran versus placebo in adults with AHP.

reasoning_trace.content: ALAS1 is the rate-limiting enzyme of hepatic heme biosynthesis; suppressing it lowers porphyrin precursor accumulation.
